data.body: AC amendment (gap G5): release_pass_lock ownership check. The lock file contains pass_id + timestamp_ns (per T2 spec). release_pass_lock MUST read the existing lock contents and verify the pass_id matches the releasing process's pass_id BEFORE deletion. On mismatch: log warning + leave file in place + return without raising (defensive — don't unlock another process). Without owner-check, parallel passes can mutually unlock each other. Add test: acquire with pass_id=X, attempt release with pass_id=Y → file remains, warning logged.
